evidence_quotes.agenda: let's talk about your move. What are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers still on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: the only big concern for me would just be the price... larger items I wouldn't be able to pick up on my own — rep pivoted straight to logistics questions with zero follow-up on the price/large-item worry
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Does that make sense so far?

top_strength: Strong opening — time-boxed quid pro quo framing (I just need about ten to fifteen minutes) and the their-agenda question both landed cleanly and in the right order.
coaching_note: The customer named price as the top concern and it was never addressed directly — no reassurance, no follow-up question — that's the single biggest miss, on top of a fully-built Save Your Ass sequence that never happened.
